mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 61 degrees and overcast near the Verona Public Library with a waxing crescent moon in the sky.

The City Council recently approved new sewer and stormwater utility rates to prevent deficits and fund necessary infrastructure repairs. Also, our I Voted sticker contest winners have been announced, featuring four local students whose designs will be used in the November election.

There is plenty happening in Verona. Today, Epic Systems is hosting their User Group Meeting, and you can join trivia night at Hop Haus or Lake Lou-ee. Tomorrow, look forward to the downtown Farmer's Market and more trivia options.
In a report from August 15, an officer initiated a stop for a swerving vehicle and subsequently arrested the driver for a first offence O W I.
Today's flavor of the day is the delicious Caramel Chocolate Pecan. Culver's is currently closed, but they will be ready to serve you when they open at 10:00 AM.
